item.subject: science
item.stem:
Sanya stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors. The diagram summarises the image of her face in each mirror.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Mirror X is a plane mirror.
options.B: Mirror Y is a concave mirror.
options.C: Mirror Z is a concave mirror because the image is erect.
options.D: Mirror Y is a convex mirror because a larger image always means a wider view.
